# Nymrel Trust Scorecard repository

> Source repository for a local-first machine-readability evidence diagnostic. The application scores versioned synthetic fixtures or bounded evidence supplied by a user; it does not fetch or live-verify websites.

## Source and operation
- Audience workflows and local engine contract: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-trust-scorecard/blob/main/docs/AUDIENCE_FLOWS.md
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-trust-scorecard
- Intended application origin: https://score.nymrel.com/
- Company: https://nymrel.com/
- Security reporting: contact@nymrel.com

## Important boundaries
- A domain alone receives no score.
- Synthetic fixtures are not current facts about any public website.
- Manual evidence remains in the browser.
- Scores, remediation candidates, badges, and share drafts are not certifications.
- A repository artifact does not prove a current production deployment.
- Source integrations branch on status: scored or unavailable. There is no hosted API or MCP endpoint in this repository.
